method.client: viem eth_call against each chain public RPC with the Safari User-Agent from src/http.ts
method.blockPolicy: Each chain was read at one pinned block. The RPC chain ID and pinned block hash were checked before and after state reads.
method.registryPolicy: Read allVaults and kept symbols starting with dyn, excluding symbols containing Test. On Base, only registry types 3 and 4 count, as in the research CLI.
method.abiPolicy: Hand-written ABI fragments. The circuit-breaker getters match IDynaVaultManager in the cached PermissionedDynaVault source at contracts/8453/0x1f1933984a5e7f36a6fa8a454224d568ab2ba257. Successful decoding shows call compatibility only.
limitations: No explorer source was fetched for non-Base deployments.
An error result for the circuit-breaker getters means the call reverted; it does not identify the deployed implementation.
Role holders were checked only for the listed accounts, not enumerated.
